citations.description: Test only asserts signed is False; no assertion for the reason field

findings.criterion: A `source=local` PASS returns `signature.signed is False` and a machine-readable unsigned reason naming the local-source policy; an interface test asserts both.
findings.detail: The implementation correctly sets `verdict["signature"] = {"signed": False, "reason": "local-source-never-signs"}` at `__init__.py:722`. However, the interface test `test_local_source_pass_is_never_signed` (test_plan_review_gate.py:1715) only asserts `verdict["signature"]["signed"] is False` — it does NOT assert the `reason` field. The AC requires the test to assert BOTH `signed is False` AND the machine-readable reason string.

citations.description: test_never_sign_guard_table: covers only BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, sign=False; docstring explicitly notes local-source is absent
Docstring explicitly states local-source is 'deliberately ABSENT' from this table

findings.criterion: A table-driven never-sign test covers BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, local-source, and explicit `sign=False`.
findings.detail: No single table-driven test covers all five cases. `test_never_sign_guard_table` (line 1586) covers BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, and sign=False — and its docstring explicitly still says 'NOTE: `source="local"` is deliberately ABSENT'. The degraded case is in a separate test `test_sign_plan_review_refuses_non_certifiable_verdicts` (line 1629) driving the signing primitive directly. The local-source case is in a separate test `test_local_source_pass_is_never_signed` (line 1715). The AC requires all five in a single table-driven test.
